column1: When the suffering world is about to uncurl and reaches up under your skin.
You might sit there alone but your about to be thrown, into a box you could never fit in.
I once knew a man who claimed he could handle anything life could throw his way.
With no such hope he was swinging from a rope seems he couldn't stand another day.
Struggling with our pride and pain and if just can't handle the strain your already dead.
